import re
def words(f):
    t = open(f, encoding='utf-8').read()
    t = re.sub(r'[.,:;?!\-()]', ' ', t)
    return t.split()

p = words('/tmp/prop.txt')
print(len(o), len(p))
print(o == p)
if o != p:
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(o,p)):
        if a != b:
            print(i, a, b)
            break
"
